privacy.title: Privacy policy (placeholder)
privacy.lastUpdated: Last updated: beta release. The final policy will be published before general availability.
privacy.p1: Account data (email, name), nutrition log data (meals, water, weight) and the meal photos you upload. Photos are stored in object storage and tied to your account.
privacy.p2: Your data is used solely to power the nutrition tracking experience: estimating calories from meal photos, computing daily and weekly summaries, and generating insights.
privacy.p3: When real AI is enabled, your meal photo and the optional note you provide are sent to our AI provider for analysis. The raw response is stored on your meal record so you can audit it later.
privacy.p4: All nutrition values are estimates. They should not replace a registered dietitian or medical professional's advice.
privacy.li1: Delete any meal — image is removed from storage.
privacy.li2: Edit any AI estimate before it counts toward daily totals.
privacy.li3: Update or remove weight/water entries any time.
privacy.li4: Account deletion is planned for the next release.
